## source_to_kb

**referral_ext_inpatient_closure** (hub `patient_confirmed_inpatient_closure_d140af5a`, baseline `inpatient_days_released_on_closure_b3a1b23e`)
- Baseline rule (patient or parent/guardian confirms an approved SNF/IMH under TRICARE Prime whose stay has ended; closed as cancelled that day; days left = granted + extended − used; standard release every day left). Carried in the baseline doc and the hub's scope. Floor at zero from the assembly.
- `readmission_split` (3 method tiers) → `readmission_split_of_inpatient_days_a1aad5b3`, including "never more than the days left". The no-use case matches compute (`i_span_after = i_left`). Complete.
- `crisis_frequency_hold` (K 2 / K 1 / 0) → `repeated_crisis_care_hold_f6ac8f33`. Complete.
- `fresh_facility_line` (K 1 / K 2 / 0; 3 days; Prime line under the authorization) → `fresh_facility_bill_hold_18e43e87`. Complete.
- `repeat_admission_reserve` (K 2 / K 1 / 0) → `repeat_admission_crisis_reserve_58b378b2`. Complete.
- `outpatient_step_down` (+1 / −1 / 0; 7 days) → `outpatient_aftercare_step_down_day_417bdbae`. The source's pointer "the same test the readmission split uses" is rendered as the test itself, without pointing at the other factor. Complete.
- Assembly ("held days subtracted from the days that count ..., any day added back is added, never fewer than zero") is entailed by each factor's "held from the release" / "added back to the release", the split document's "days that count toward the release", and the baseline floor.
- Prerequisite: none in the source, and the hub states none.
- Overwrite (release clause of referral_cancellation_and_expiry) → `cancellation_and_expiry` "Earlier release clause ... no longer in force". The remaining clauses are in force.
- Tool contract (owner user; patient or parent/guardian confirms in person; parameters, receipt) → hub. Matches task_tools.py.

**referral_ext_rofr_lapse_approval** (hub `approval_after_first_refusal_window_lapses_4a16ad9b`, baseline `span_and_days_on_prime_approval_ab3e6bac`)
- Baseline rule (Prime request of a right-of-first-refusal type still submitted after the window with no answer and no duplicate → approved to the requested network provider; span under the start rule for validity days; days = lesser of requested / default / max). Carried. The assembly's "never fewer than one, never more than requested or max" is in the baseline doc.
- `readmission_initial_block` (K 3 / K 5 / default; 7-day ED recency; IMH admission line in the last month) → `readmission_initial_block_5cd5b905`. Complete.
- `aftercare_engagement` (−1 / +2 / 0; 3 visits in 3 months; none in 12 months) → `aftercare_engagement_on_approval_7f25b6e8`. Complete.
- `emergency_frequency` (2 / 1 / 0) → `emergency_frequency_days_on_approval_b9f26d8f`. Complete.
- `repeat_admissions` (2 / 1 / 0) → `repeat_admission_days_on_approval_4ba7b429`. Complete.
- `readmission_pacing` (halve and round up for 1–7 days; round up to whole intervals for 8–30 days when the type has an interval; else as set) → `rapid_readmission_pacing_fa536848`, with the per-type interval table (HH 60, SNF 14, IMH 3, others 0). Complete.
- Assembly "paced block plus the aftercare, emergency and repeat-admission days" is entailed. The pacing doc acts on "the initial block" that readmission_initial_block sets, and the adders act on "the days approved".
- **Prerequisite** (form state): "A pending inpatient mental health request is not approved until every other inpatient mental health authorization of the patient with a different servicing provider whose validity span is still running shows as cancelled or exhausted." Verbatim in the hub ("Conditions of the approval", fourth bullet). A same-form restatement is in the same hub ("Restated for the inpatient mental health case: while another ... shows a status other than cancelled or exhausted, the pending inpatient mental health request is not approved."). Not in any other document. Resolution basis: closure hub "The authorization's status becomes cancelled" plus records (other IMH authorization, servicing provider, valid_through ≥ today, status). Hard gate, same strength and connective.
- Overwrites: validity_and_units units clause → `validity_span_and_approved_units` retired. Multi-holding clause → `holding_several_authorizations_48f8574d` "Clause 1 (no longer in force)", with its replacement ("A patient holds only one open inpatient mental health authorization at a time ...") in the hub. Requirement-by-plan enrollment clause → `plan_based_authorization_requirement_ef7bc054` "Earlier enrollment clause (no longer in force)", with its replacement ("For a TRICARE Prime request, the patient holds an active TRICARE Prime enrollment on the request date.") in the hub. The other clauses of each base policy are still stated in force.
- Base rules this approval rests on (right of first refusal, duplicate rule, plan rule, review clocks, program conditions, active duty review, validity/start rule) are carried in their documents (see 0.md table). Figures checked: IMH rofr 1 business day, start rule admission date, 7 validity days, 7 default, 37 max.
- Tool contract → hub. Matches.

**referral_ext_stay_extension** (hub `extension_of_approved_authorizations_a49d4039`, baseline `days_added_by_an_extension_2b584309`)
- Baseline rule (provider asks to extend an approved authorization of an extendable type; last day moves out by extension validity days; days added = extension units, never more than room under the maximum after granted and earlier extensions). Carried. The assembly's "never fewer than zero, nothing once the type's maximum extensions is reached" is in the baseline doc.
- `readmission_block` (K 5 / K 4 / extension units) → `readmission_extension_block_4f4075d4`. Complete.
- `review_timing` (halve and round up when fewer than half of the validity days have passed; +1 bridging day when the last day is today or past; else as set) → `extension_timing_within_the_span_c7353237`, with the per-type half-way table. Complete.
- `aftercare_step_down` (−1 / +1 / 0) → `aftercare_step_down_on_extension_6ff29935`. Complete.
- `unit_span_netting` (excess off / shortfall rounded up to whole intervals or as it stands / none; span days ahead counting today) → `netting_units_on_hand_against_span_c6e6e133`, with the interval table. Complete.
- `readmission_interval` (K 2 for 1–7 days / K 1 for 8–30 days / 0) → `close_readmission_extension_days_2ef76c36`. Complete.
- `emergency_frequency_block` (2 / 1 / 0) → `emergency_frequency_extension_days_62c211ee`. Complete.
- **Prerequisite** (form state): "The days an extension adds are fixed only after the authorization's unit history shows a grant on an initial approval." Verbatim in the hub (second paragraph), and only there. Resolution basis: approval hub "One grant entry on the basis of an initial approval is added to its unit history" plus the record (submitted request, empty ledger). Hard gate, same strength.
- Overwrite (referral_extension unit clause) → `extension_eligibility_and_deadline_11e8d53b` "Earlier extension clause (no longer in force)". The deadline, late/over-limit and extensions-granted clauses are stated in force. `extension_limits_table_1c43a1cc` keeps the parameters. Its illustration "each extension adds 12 visits" equals the current baseline block (extension units) and doesn't contradict the computation document.
- Tool contract → hub. Matches.

## kb_to_source

The same whole-corpus reverse scan as 0.md applies; it was re-read for this tree's documents. No added obligation, confirmation, wait, review, notification or procedure. No task's world state is written as policy: illustrations are hypothetical, and none uses Kayla's dates or facilities. No cross-problem operational guidance: the three task tools of this tree each appear only in their own hub.

Policy-side notes (not KB verdicts):
- PS4 The provider's request to extend is a rule actor ("the requesting or servicing provider asks") with no record-borne evidence in the source. At runtime it rests on the parent's relay. The KB carries the source's wording.
- PS5 The inpatient start rule "the admission date" has no record field when the facility hasn't billed yet. It is taken from the request date and the caller.

## bijection_verdict

**PASS (task 1).** The three extended policies (rule, baseline, 16 factor ladders with all figures, two prerequisites, five overwrites) and their governing base policies correspond losslessly at the level of entailment. No previous revision.
